Thank you for shining a little light on the water situation in southern West Virginia. As I understand it, these issues in Wayne county are precipitated by the abandoned coal mines and/or mine reclamation efforts - and entire communities are affected and without usable water. The companies and corporations who have caused these issues have largely taken the money and run long ago...
I'm not particularly interested in "the politics" of arriving at this point, because, to be honest, neither "party" has served the people of West Virginia to any degree, as compared to how they've served themselves and their own interests and those of their cronies. I do find it appalling, however, that some commentors are so arrogant that they blame the people's "ignorance" in having been deceived, used, abused, and pillaged for years, and want to turn the situation into some sort of springboard for bringing up their political opinions. Government got us here. I have absolutely no expectations that they will somehow "save us". As long as big bucks and big talk go unchecked, we're going to be taken advantage of - and, when we start saying NO to their schemes and scams, they'll just find new victims...
The lack of accountability - on every level - in this country is going to be our undoing...
